scope: Root synthesis: evaluation, data, detectors and pipeline engineering

sources.title: A Survey of Deep Learning in Sports Applications: Perception, Comprehension, and Decision
claims: Perception/comprehension/decision taxonomy; citation discovery.
caveats: Method results traced to original sources; not all cited papers read.

sources.title: HOTA: A Higher Order Metric for Evaluating Multi-Object Tracking
claims: Detection and association should both be evaluated.
caveats: Not a complete one-ball visibility/coordinate scorecard.

sources.title: TrackEval HOTA implementation
claims: Thresholded matching, DetA/AssA combination, sequence aggregation; old np.float usage.
caveats: Not executed; current NumPy compatibility requires attention.

sources.title: TIDE: A General Toolbox for Identifying Object Detection Errors
claims: Error decomposition is more diagnostic than one aggregate AP.
caveats: Box/segmentation implementation is not directly equivalent to our point labels.

sources.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
claims: Selective prediction evaluates risk together with coverage.
caveats: Classification results do not transfer as guarantees to basketball sequences.

sources.title: Multivariate Confidence Calibration for Object Detection
claims: Detection confidence calibration can depend on scale and location.
caveats: No basketball calibration reproduced.

sources.title: scikit-learn cross-validation guide
claims: Held-out tuning leakage and grouped dependent observations.
caveats: Game/episode split is our application, not a benchmark supplied by sklearn.

sources.title: CVAT native annotation format
claims: Video tracked shapes/points, attributes, track states.
caveats: No existing annotation migration performed.

sources.title: FiftyOne uniqueness tutorial
sources.inspection_depth: search-index excerpt only; direct open failed
claims: Diverse sample and near-duplicate tooling lead.
caveats: No code inspected or capability exercised.

sources.title: Temporal Coherence for Active Learning in Videos
sources.inspection_depth: publisher abstract and indexed paper excerpt
claims: Temporal representativeness matters for video labeling.
caveats: Road scenes; basketball episode sampling is a transfer proposal.

sources.title: DVC running pipelines
claims: Dependency-aware caching, stage invalidation, output replacement behavior.
caveats: Optional architecture reference; no migration or commands run.

sources.title: MLflow Tracking
claims: Run metadata, parameters, metrics and artifacts can be logged separately.
caveats: Optional tooling; no new service installed.

sources.title: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
claims: Data dependencies and hidden consumers create system complexity.
caveats: Our simplification recommendations are engineering judgments.

sources.title: PyTorch Profiler recipe
claims: CPU/CUDA profiling to locate real runtime cost.
caveats: No local profiling or performance claim made.

sources.title: RF-DETR paper v1
claims: Specialist target-domain training, architecture search and latency measurement conditions.
caveats: COCO/RF100-VL are not our basketball task; v1 is distinct from live code.

sources.title: RF-DETR official repository snapshot
sources.inspection_depth: README, license and official training docs; API revision checked
claims: Model resources and component-specific license statements.
caveats: Live upstream differs from project rfdetr1.9.1; not executed.

sources.title: RF-DETR source license
claims: Apache-2.0 source license.
caveats: Does not establish that all Plus components or data have the same terms.

sources.title: Ultralytics YOLO26 documentation
claims: Current head selection, training changes, model resource links and AGPL/Enterprise terms.
caveats: No YOLO26 basketball evaluation; our measured negative result is YOLO11x-specific.

sources.title: SAHI paper v1
claims: Slicing and slicing-assisted fine-tuning for small objects.
caveats: Aerial benchmarks do not establish basketball selection performance.

sources.title: SAHI get_sliced_prediction implementation
claims: Overlap, optional full-image inference and candidate merging are explicit choices.
caveats: Not run or substituted for existing crop implementation.

sources.title: SAHI license
claims: MIT source license.
caveats: Detector/weights retain separate terms.

sources.title: Grounding DINO paper
claims: Language-conditioned open-set detection.
caveats: No exact-coordinate or ball-reacquisition guarantee.

sources.title: Grounding DINO official implementation
sources.inspection_depth: README and model links; API revision checked
claims: Open implementation/checkpoint links, Apache-2.0 code declaration.
caveats: Original release distinct from later APIs; separate weight/data terms not fully resolved.

sources.title: Grounding DINO inference implementation
claims: Caption normalization, resizing and box/text thresholds.
caveats: Not executed; no local performance comparison.

sources.title: RT-DETR official repository
claims: Official Paddle/PyTorch implementations and checkpoint/custom-data references.
caveats: Deferred alternative; full license/dependency/code audit not done.

sources.title: D-FINE official repository
claims: ICLR2025 detector regression-refinement implementation lead.
caveats: Discovery-level alternative; no code reproduction or basketball checkpoint verified.

sources.title: DEIM official repository
claims: CVPR2025 improved matching/training implementation lead.
caveats: Discovery-level alternative; no code reproduction or basketball result verified.

sources.title: OpenCV homography tutorial
claims: Homography is a planar relationship; camera geometry requires its assumptions.
caveats: Airborne-ball discussion is also covered by specialist chapter; no local geometry changed.

revision_note: GitHub API metadata inspected read-only. Repository head is a snapshot anchor, not a claim that every file or release was reviewed. Live documentation may change.
